import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SafeHash {
        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            // http://xorshift.di.unimi.it/splitmix64.c
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        long operator()(long x) {
            static long FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() * (System.identityHashCode(new Object()) | 1));
            return splitmix64(x ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0)
                v = v % 1000000007 + 1000000007;

            if (v >= 1000000007)
                v %= 1000000007;

            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extended_Euclidean_algorithm#Example
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;

            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            this((long) v);
        }

        ModInt operator+(ModInt other) {
            int sum = val + other.val;
            if (sum >= 1000000007)
                sum -= 1000000007;
            return new ModInt(sum);
        }

        ModInt operator-(ModInt other) {
            int diff = val - other.val;
            if (diff < 0)
                diff += 1000000007;
            return new ModInt(diff);
        }

        ModInt operator*(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt((long) val * other.val % 1000000007);
        }

        ModInt operator/(ModInt other) {
            return this * other.inv();
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, 1000000007));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert(p >= 0);
            ModInt a = this, result = new ModInt(1);

            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1)
                    result = result * a;

                a = a * a;
                p >>= 1;
            }

            return result;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p) / new ModInt(100);
            }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++)
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt, SafeHash> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put((long) 1 << masksWithCount.get(0).get(0), new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt, SafeHash> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++)
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++)
                    products[current] = products[current] * (current >> right & 1 ? probability[left][right] : new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]));

            int[] newBits = new int[N];
            int[] newPossible = new int[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = p.getKey();
                ModInt prob = p.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0);

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left))
                    if ((possible >> masksWithCount.get(left).get(mask)) % 2 == 1)
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0)
                                newBits[i] |= 1 << masksWithCount.get(left).get(mask | 1 << i);

                newPossible[0] = 0;

                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[__builtin_ctz(current)];
                    newPossibleMasks.put(newPossible[current], newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(newPossible[current], new ModInt(0)) + prob * products[current]);
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            pw.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);

        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet())
            if ((p.getKey() >> masksWithCount.get(N).get((1 << N) - 1)) % 2 == 1)
                answer = answer + p.getValue();

        pw.println(answer.val);

        pw.close();
    }
}
